# Palette Animation Analysis in Room 7 (2026-01-27 13:52Z)

_**User (2026-01-27 17:27Z)**_

in room 7, when using object number 7 (the amulet) in the hotspot 353 (the statue), theres a palette animation happening that transforms the colors of the statue into something more reddish, through a fade effect in several colors. After a conversation with the character (starting root 1, so the second one for this npc, the only one in the room), the palette reverts back to the original.  I dont believe this is a different palette, just a palette fade on multiple colors. 

We have not identified a palette animation so far in room 7. I need you to see where this animation comes from and how it is applied. The palette before the animation, as extracted from a Dosbox raw screenshot is:
